epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce account ban rate by 95% due to flood control violations
requirements: R1: Track outbound message count per Telegram account per 24 hours.
R2: Halt dispatches for an account when it reaches the 15-20 daily limit.

slices.title: Implement Daily Outbound Messaging Rate Limiter
slices.jtbd: When implementing the rate limiter for this epic, I want to track and enforce daily limits in the dispatcher code, so that the account lifespan is maximized.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an active Telegram account and a campaign task,
When messages are dispatched,
Then the system must track outbound counts per account.
Given the outbound count reaches the daily limit,
When the next dispatch is attempted,
Then the system must halt dispatches for that account.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero flood control bans triggered by exceeding daily limits

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase campaign uptime from failure to recovery to under 1 second
requirements: R1: Catch FLOOD_WAIT errors and daily limit triggers during message dispatch.
R2: Dynamically rotate the active task to the next eligible account in the pool.

slices.title: Implement Automatic Session Rotation and Failover
slices.jtbd: When implementing failover logic for this epic, I want to catch limits and errors to dynamically switch accounts, so that campaigns run continuously.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a campaign running across a pool of connected Telegram accounts,
When the active account encounters a FLOOD_WAIT error,
Then the task must rotate to the next eligible account.
Given the active account reaches its daily limit,
When a dispatch is triggered,
Then the task must seamlessly shift to the next available account.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% automated recovery on FLOOD_WAIT errors without manual intervention

epics.title: Unified Frontend Integration for Platform Admin Panel
epics.jtbd: When managing the platform, I want the Svelte UI to interact with backend REST controllers, so that operators can onboard accounts, import campaign lists, and read or reply to live conversation streams in real time.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease mock data usage from 100% to 0% across ACC, CMP, and CRM views in the Svelte UI
requirements: R1: Integrate Svelte admin panel with OTP/session onboarding REST API.
R2: Integrate Svelte admin panel with lead CSV list ingestion REST API.
R3: Integrate Svelte admin panel with unified chat inbox REST API.

slices.title: Wire Svelte Views to REST Backend APIs
slices.jtbd: When implementing API integrations for this epic, I want to replace static mock data with real HTTP calls, so that the admin panel reflects live backend state.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the Svelte admin panel,
When an operator uploads a CSV list,
Then the frontend must communicate with the ingest REST API.
Given the Svelte admin panel,
When an operator onboards an account,
Then the frontend must successfully complete the OTP flow with the backend.
Given the Svelte admin panel,
When an operator views or sends messages,
Then the unified inbox must sync with the live CRM API.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% of UI actions correctly persisted via backend REST APIs
